desc: Implement the dual offline sweep: compute dp[j] via value-rank max-Fenwick (strict via rank-1), answer queries by sorting queries on X and positions on A_j, activating with a point update of dp[j] into an index max-Fenwick and answering prefix-max over [1,R].
Confirm strict inequality handling (rank-1 for dp), equal values, and X exceeding all A values are handled correctly.
Verify O((N+Q) log N) performance and correctness against both public samples (Sample 1 → 2,1,2; Sample 2 → 4,1,1,2,1,5,3,4), with fast IO via sys.stdin.buffer.read().split().
Persistent segment tree alternative (not needed: dual sweep is correct and within time/memory limits).
